weaknesses.title: LOOKUP/KVSET/KVINC sep cannot be a variable
weaknesses.detail: SYS LOOKUP bag key SEP fails unknown form 'SEP'. KVINC/KVSET only accept TK_STR for sep; LOOKUP bare IDENT only if strlen<=2. Configurable CUBALC_SE_SEP forces EQS branch + duplicated ops with ":"/"=" literals. BEFORE/AFTER accept vars — inconsistent.
weaknesses.repro: LET SEP=":"; SYS LOOKUP bag k SEP → unknown form

weaknesses.title: KVINC silently coerces non-numeric values to 0
weaknesses.detail: error:abc +1 → error:1 with KVINC_HIT=1. No OK=0 / refuse mode for non-numeric. Corrupts string metadata plates if reused as counters.

weaknesses.title: Duplicate keys: first-wins only; residual siblings stay
weaknesses.detail: LOOKUP/KVINC touch only first matching key. error:3\nerror:9 bump → error:4\nerror:9. No de-dupe or multi-key bump. Agents must UNIQ/normalize first.

weaknesses.title: No floor/clamp on negative KVINC delta
weaknesses.detail: bump -2 from 5 → 3 ok; can go negative freely. Budget-like agents need MIN 0 after every bump.

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON collapses bag newlines
weaknesses.detail: PRINT_JSON LAST shows error:1warn:1 not multi-line. Agents misread plate depth from JSON dump.

weaknesses.title: Empty-key KVINC can produce malformed fields
weaknesses.detail: KVINC bag '' 1 may yield a:1:1 or :n depending on bag. No key validation.

weaknesses.title: No KVDEL / drop-by-key primitive
weaknesses.detail: Must LOOKUP → LOOKUP_LINE → REMOVELINE. Works but multi-step; residual dups need loop.

workarounds: Branch EQS SEP "=" then call with ":" or "=" string literals only
Never store non-numeric values in counter plates; validate before KVINC
Normalize with UNIQ/FREQ before tallies to avoid duplicate keys
After negative delta SYS MAX 0 or reject delta < 0 at agent layer
Drop via LOOKUP_LINE + REMOVELINE; loop while LOOKUP hits for dups
language_gaps: resolve_str_arg for LOOKUP/KVSET/KVINC optional sep (accept vars)
PRINT_JSON preserve bag newlines or bag-as-array
